# Recruitment Bonuses

The game gives `templerec`, `libraryrec`, `atavirec` and a `$` in `reclimiter` a fixed table of bonuses, and stops counting at 5 temples and 10 library levels. With CoE5SE you define the table. Make everything rare with talent hard to find, or drown your users in mages.

They go right after the `addunitrec`, `addmercrec` or `addcomrec` they change. A later line for the same offer replaces an earlier one, and `clearrec` removes the class's bonuses with its offers.

!!! info "More in the game's manual"
    The game's own recruitment commands are in Illwinter's official modding manual, under ["Class Modding"](https://www.illwinter.com/coe5/coe5modding.pdf#page=27).

### templerec &lt;amount&gt; [&lt;cap&gt;] <span class="new-badge">New</span> { #templerec .command data-toc-label="templerec" data-added="2.10" }

The game's `templerec` adds a fixed amount for each temple the player owns, set by the offer's own chance, up to 5 temples:

| Offer's chance | Each temple adds | 5 temples add |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 9% or more | 4% | 20% |
| 3% to 8% | 3% | 15% |
| 0% to 2% | 2% | 10% |

With CoE5SE you set the amount, and every temple counts.

- **amount:** The chance added for each temple, 0% to 100%.
- **cap:** The most temples that count, 0 to 1000. Without it, every temple counts.

=== ".c5se"

    The game's table, on a 6% commander (only 5 temples count):

    ```c5se
    addcomrec "Elven Mage" 6 120 20 0
    templerec      # 8 temples at 21%
    ```

    Or your own, every temple counting:

    ```c5se
    addcomrec "Elven Mage" 6 120 20 0
    templerec 4    # 8 temples at 38%
    ```

=== ".c5m"

    The game's table, on a 6% commander (only 5 temples count):

    ```c5m
    addcomrec "Elven Mage" 6 120 20 0
    templerec      # 8 temples at 21%
    ```

    Or your own, every temple counting:

    ```c5m
    addcomrec "Elven Mage" 6 120 20 0
    templerec 4    # 8 temples at 38%
    ```

### libraryrec &lt;amount&gt; [&lt;cap&gt;] <span class="new-badge">New</span> { #libraryrec .command data-toc-label="libraryrec" data-added="2.10" }

The game's `libraryrec` adds a fixed amount for each library level on the squares the player owns, up to 10 levels:

| Offer's chance | Each level adds | 10 levels add |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 9% or more | 3% | 30% |
| 3% to 8% | 2% | 20% |
| 0% to 2% | 1% | 10% |

With CoE5SE you set the amount, and every level counts.

- **amount:** The chance added for each library level, 0% to 100%.
- **cap:** The most library levels that count, 0 to 1000. Without it, every level counts.

=== ".c5se"

    The game's table, on a 3% commander (only 10 levels count):

    ```c5se
    addcomrec "Grey Wizard" 3 150 20 0
    libraryrec         # 20 library levels at 23%
    ```

    Or your own, with a limit of 15:

    ```c5se
    addcomrec "Grey Wizard" 3 150 20 0
    libraryrec 3 15    # 20 library levels at 48%
    ```

=== ".c5m"

    The game's table, on a 3% commander (only 10 levels count):

    ```c5m
    addcomrec "Grey Wizard" 3 150 20 0
    libraryrec         # 20 library levels at 23%
    ```

    Or your own, with a limit of 15:

    ```c5m
    addcomrec "Grey Wizard" 3 150 20 0
    libraryrec 3 15    # 20 library levels at 48%
    ```

### atavirec &lt;amount&gt; [&lt;cap&gt;] <span class="new-badge">New</span> { #atavirec .command data-toc-label="atavirec" data-added="2.10" }

The game's `atavirec` adds a fixed amount for each Atavi Tribe Village the player owns, with no limit:

| Offer's chance | Each village adds |
| --- | --- |
| 9% or more | 3% |
| 3% to 8% | 2% |
| 0% to 2% | 1% |

With CoE5SE you set the amount.

- **amount:** The chance added for each village, 0% to 100%.
- **cap:** The most villages that count, 0 to 1000. Without it, every village counts.

=== ".c5se"

    The game's table, on a 10% offer:

    ```c5se
    addunitrec "Hobbit Archer" 10 5 30 5 0
    atavirec      # 4 Atavi villages at 22%
    ```

    Or your own:

    ```c5se
    addunitrec "Hobbit Archer" 10 5 30 5 0
    atavirec 6    # 4 Atavi villages at 34%
    ```

=== ".c5m"

    The game's table, on a 10% offer:

    ```c5m
    addunitrec "Hobbit Archer" 10 5 30 5 0
    atavirec      # 4 Atavi villages at 22%
    ```

    Or your own:

    ```c5m
    addunitrec "Hobbit Archer" 10 5 30 5 0
    atavirec 6    # 4 Atavi villages at 34%
    ```

### reclimiter "$&lt;monster&gt;" &lt;amount&gt; [&lt;cap&gt;] <span class="new-badge">New</span> { #reclimiter .command data-toc-label="reclimiter" data-added="2.10" }

The game's `reclimiter` with a `$` adds a fixed amount for each unit of that monster the player has, anywhere, with no limit:

| Offer's chance | Each unit adds |
| --- | --- |
| 9% or more | 3% |
| 3% to 8% | 2% |
| 0% to 2% | 1% |

With CoE5SE you set the amount.

- **monster:** A monster's name after the `$`, as in the game's `reclimiter`.
- **amount:** The chance added for each unit, 0% to 100%.
- **cap:** The most units that count, 0 to 1000. Without it, every unit counts.

=== ".c5se"

    The game's table, on a 2% offer of 5 Rangers:

    ```c5se
    addunitrec "Ranger of Ithilien" 2 5 60 0 5
    reclimiter "$Tower Guard of Minas Tirith"     # 20 Tower Guards at 22%
    ```

    Or your own:

    ```c5se
    addunitrec "Ranger of Ithilien" 2 5 60 0 5
    reclimiter "$Tower Guard of Minas Tirith" 3   # 20 Tower Guards at 62%
    ```

=== ".c5m"

    The game's table, on a 2% offer of 5 Rangers:

    ```c5m
    addunitrec "Ranger of Ithilien" 2 5 60 0 5
    reclimiter "$Tower Guard of Minas Tirith"     # 20 Tower Guards at 22%
    ```

    Or your own:

    ```c5m
    addunitrec "Ranger of Ithilien" 2 5 60 0 5
    reclimiter "$Tower Guard of Minas Tirith" 3   # 20 Tower Guards at 62%
    ```

A `-` limiter, `humancost 999` or a priest level the offer needs sets the chance to 0 after `templerec`, `libraryrec` and `atavirec` count, so it wipes their bonus. A `$` line counts later, in its place among the `reclimiter` lines, so it lifts that 0, unless a `-` line below it sets 0 again.

!!! tip "For players without CoE5SE"
    Their game reads the command without the numbers and uses its own table.

### Example class { #example }

=== ".c5se"

    ```c5se
    newmonster "Tower Guard of Minas Tirith"
    copystats "Heavy Infantry"
    copyspr "Heavy Infantry"

    newmonster "Ranger of Ithilien"
    copystats "Archer"
    copyspr "Archer"

    newclass
    setclassname "Stewards of Gondor"
    hometerr 156
    setmaincom "Grey Wizard"
    addstartunits "Ranger of Ithilien" 4
    addunitrec "Tower Guard of Minas Tirith" 5 5 60 10 10
    templerec 4
    reclimiter "$Ranger of Ithilien" 2
    addcomrec "Elven Mage" 3 120 20 0
    libraryrec 5
    ```

=== ".c5m"

    ```c5m
    newmonster "Tower Guard of Minas Tirith"
    copystats "Heavy Infantry"
    copyspr "Heavy Infantry"

    newmonster "Ranger of Ithilien"
    copystats "Archer"
    copyspr "Archer"

    newclass
    setclassname "Stewards of Gondor"
    hometerr 156
    setmaincom "Grey Wizard"
    addstartunits "Ranger of Ithilien" 4
    addunitrec "Tower Guard of Minas Tirith" 5 5 60 10 10
    templerec 4
    reclimiter "$Ranger of Ithilien" 2
    addcomrec "Elven Mage" 3 120 20 0
    libraryrec 5
    ```
